findings.claim: External-context traces contain 21 model tool calls rejected at argument validation, including one six-turn identical missing-path loop.
findings.causal_evidence: Each cited event records ok:false and the exact validator issue. In the six-turn loop, all six calls made no staging progress and their corresponding model receipts consumed 50,552 input plus 2,836 output tokens.
findings.opportunity: Return compact, example-bearing corrective arguments after validation failure and enforce a same-error circuit breaker before another full model turn. Test missing required fields, array/object confusions, and numeric bounds separately.

findings.claim: Three model receipts finish at the output cap and all three enclosing external attempts end run_error with incomplete-output.
findings.causal_evidence: The enclosing result explicitly reports error=incomplete-output; this supports causation within each attempt, while the rarity does not support a broad population claim.
findings.opportunity: Reserve a compact terminal-only schema path, detect near-cap tool output, and prevent unsuccessful staging feedback from expanding the final response context.

findings.claim: Selected attempt representations expose complete input/output usage for 6,122 of 6,176 model receipts; 54 receipts are missing usage, including 30 in live/provider evidence and 24 offline-synthetic fitting rows. The observed 23,861,101-token subtotal is not a definitive global total because cross-wrapper lineage is not proven.
findings.causal_evidence: This is accounting coverage, not a quality claim. Cached input remains part of input tokens; reasoning is a subset of output and is not added twice.
findings.opportunity: Make terminal receipts carry an explicit usage_known flag and zero-versus-unknown semantics. Do not publish a definitive grand total while 30 live receipts lack usage.

findings.claim: H23 removed redundant envelope fields while preserving payloads; exact tokenizer pairs saved 316/320/319 input tokens and changed all three observed near-boundary requests from rejected to admitted.
findings.causal_evidence: The matched tokenizer intervention directly changes admission for 3/3 observed requests; payload-heavy negative controls reject in both arms. In the frozen live comparison, near-boundary tasks pass 3/3 with H23 versus 0/3 with H21, with all six unpressured controls passing. Generalization remains limited to the fixed task family.
findings.opportunity: Prioritize schema-preserving payload projection at measured admission boundaries; retain full envelopes in sidecars and preserve pass-through for unsupported schemas.

findings.claim: H21 admission-first retention yields delayed correct first proposals 6/6 versus baseline 0/6 with 66 model calls in each arm; one baseline timeout keeps the frozen evaluator formally inconclusive.
findings.causal_evidence: Five delayed pairs are fully observed wins and one pairs candidate success with baseline transport failure. The result proves a narrow retention benefit without proving the sixth code comparison or general reliability.
findings.opportunity: Attempt complete inspected history before destructive masking when actual admission permits it, while preserving timeout attribution as unknown.

findings.claim: External traces contain 121 exact repeated read_file calls: 19 in 9 patch-submitted attempts, 76 in 9 unable attempts, and 26 in 6 run-error attempts.
findings.causal_evidence: This is co-occurrence only. Repeated reads also appear in successful attempts, so rereading is not automatically waste; longer failing trajectories are a confounder.
findings.opportunity: Expose exact path/range progress and freshness in the model view, then measure whether avoidable exact rereads fall without reducing recovery or correctness.

findings.claim: GLM visible traces record 76 delivery.read-deferred and 12 completion.repeat-read-deferred observations; these are deliberate controller outcomes rather than malformed tool events.
findings.causal_evidence: The observations carry explicit reason codes. Their later correctness/token effect requires episode-level matched analysis and is not inferred from the count.
findings.opportunity: Keep deferred-read reason codes machine-visible and test whether more actionable next-call guidance reduces later calls without weakening one-read-per-turn and repeat-read protections.

open_questions: What usage, if any, was billed for the 30 live/provider receipts that lack input/output fields?
Which repeated reads were required by freshness, recovery, or source-pin rules versus avoidable loss of progress state?
Do schema examples or a repeated-error circuit breaker reduce invalid calls on held-out tasks without increasing prompt tokens more than they save?
Do H21 and H23 replicate outside the fixed task families and near-boundary conditions?
